label: Service price charged to the farmer
basis: base is the midpoint of the cited range
source: Agri Farming, drone spraying cost per acre (2026-06-07): Rs 400-800 service only; Leher, drone spraying cost per acre: Rs 300-700

label: Drone purchase price
basis: low 10 L drone, base 16 L drone (retail list prices); high is the largest package the scheme subsidises in full (Rs 8 lakh cap / 80%)
source: xboom.in agriculture drone prices (updated 2026-08-29); PIB PRID 2070029 (2024-11-01)

label: Namo Drone Didi central assistance, share of package cost
basis: scheme terms; the report toggles subsidy on or off, default off (no extension past 2025-26 found as of 2026-09-24)
source: PIB PRID 2070029 (2024-11-01); Lok Sabha answer, PIB PRID 2244648 (2026-03-24)

label: Acres sprayed per working day
basis: low and base from the scheme guidelines; high is the low end of a vendor's 40-50 claim
source: PIB PRID 2070029 (2024-11-01): 20 acres a day; Leher, drone spraying cost per acre: 40-50 acres a day

label: Acres sprayed per drone per year
basis: base and high are the scheme's target range (a target, not an observed figure); low from a vendor's operator figure
source: PIB PRID 2070029 (2024-11-01): at least 2,000 to 2,500 acres a year; Leher, drone spraying cost per acre: operators handling 1,000+ acres a year

label: Battery charge cycles before replacement
basis: no Indian source found; figures are for larger, non-Indian drones. Treat as a what-if parameter
source: University of Missouri Extension G1274 (1,000 cycles or 5 years); Leher (DJI Agras T10, 1,000 cycles); DJI Agras T25/T50 battery listings (1,500-cycle warranty)

label: Price of one battery set
basis: base is an Indian maker's list price for a 12S 21,000 mAh pack (2026-09-24)
source: mPower agriculture spraying batteries, list price 2026-09-24; Leher: about Rs 18,500 per pack

label: Acres sprayed per battery charge
basis: derived: 15-minute flight time of a 10 L drone divided by 7-8 minutes per acre
source: ADRTC study via PIB PRID 2149706 (2025-07-29): one acre in 7-8 minutes; Garuda Kissan 10 L specification on xboom.in: 15-minute flight time

label: Drone useful life
basis: US university assumption for larger drones; no Indian source found

label: Scheme's expected additional income per SHG
basis: scheme's stated aim; a reference line, not a cost
source: PIB explainer, Namo Drone Didi (November 2024): additional income of at least Rs 1 lakh per year
